title: SQLite 3.54's diskused command needs a build flag sqlite3_analyzer never required
why_read: A concrete, measured comparison of SQLite's new built-in diskused command versus the old sqlite3_analyzer tool, including a build-flag gotcha that silently breaks it.
analysis: SQLite 3.54 replaces the separate sqlite3_analyzer utility with a built-in diskused() SQL function and .diskused shell command that uses the existing dbstat virtual table internally instead of a standalone cold scan. The author actually built both versions from source and benchmarked them on a 20MB test database, finding the new command roughly 2.4x faster, and importantly discovered it fails silently with no error on builds lacking the SQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB flag. That silent-failure gotcha is a genuinely useful, specific, actionable finding for anyone maintaining SQLite-based tooling or build configs. This is a good example of a small but well-executed practical investigation rather than a surface-level announcement rehash.
